newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular acquires US Electrical.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular acquires US Electrical.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said it purchased US Electrical Products Corp, an electrical engineering and design firm in New Jersey.

Applied Cellular said US Electrical's current bid proposals could eventually generate between $10 million and $12 million in additional work in 1997. Financial terms of the purchase were not announced.
Applied Cellular is a software and cellular communications company with operations in the custom electrical controls development industry.
The company's shares were up 3/8 Thursday at five.
